newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso dips to 1,073.8 amid steady trading.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso dips to 1,073.8 amid steady trading.

text.p: Colombia's peso dipped 1.8 pesos to 1,073.8 against the dollar in steady trading Monday, interbank dealers said.
Dollar export earnings from flowers and coffee flowed into the markets, dealers said. Some banks also moved to shorten dollar positions.
The peso opened at 1,073 to the dollar, hit an intraday high of 1,072.7 and sank to a low of 1,074.5. Dealers reported 338 trades worth a total $156 million.
